summary: Comprehensive backend & UI smoke testing of MDJ Scholarship portal. All 34 backend integration tests PASSED covering auth (register/login/me/duplicate/invalid), profile GET+PUT, registration draft/submit, document upload/replace/list/delete, public+super-admin site content (get/update/banner + student forbidden), admin/super-admin stats/participants list/detail/status-update, super admin user CRUD (create/list/toggle/delete + self-deactivation & primary super delete guards), and role gating (student blocked from admin/*; admin blocked from super_admin-only routes). Frontend smoke test verified: landing loads with dynamic site content from GET /api/site/content, super admin login routes to /super-admin dashboard rendering stats + trend chart + status distribution, student register auto-logs-in and routes to /dashboard showing profile completion (14%) + doc counter + status card.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines and starting to get large; consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, site, documents) for maintainability if it grows further.

GET /api/files/{path} allows ANY authenticated user (including students) to download any storage_path they can guess. Since paths include UUIDs this is largely safe, but consider restricting student downloads to their own user_id-prefixed paths for defense-in-depth.

Environment sends CORS_ORIGINS='*' while allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Currently works only because frontend uses Bearer header (not cookies) cross-origin. Recommend restricting CORS_ORIGINS to the actual frontend origin.
No auth rate-limiting / brute-force lockout implemented (login endpoint accepts unlimited attempts). Playbook expects lockout after 5 failed attempts.
Landing page calls /api/auth/me for unauthenticated visitors producing expected 401 console noise; could suppress by only calling when a token exists in localStorage.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (smoke: landing + super admin login + student register)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (serial). The suite is written with module-scoped fixtures so state flows across classes; xdist loadscope splits across workers and breaks fixture visibility. All endpoints under /api verified. Frontend uses data-testids: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button, reg-name-input, reg-email-input, reg-password-input, reg-confirm-input, register-submit-button. Super admin dashboard is at /super-admin, student at /dashboard, admin at /admin.
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found. Initial pytest failures were test-side issues (email case-sensitivity when backend lowercases input, and xdist loadscope splitting module-scoped fixtures across workers). Fixed by lowercasing test emails and running with -n 0.
